prospects.thesis: Leidos tops the screen with the highest composite score, strong 1M momentum (+17.2%), and an attractive 0.9x P/S valuation — a rare combination in today's defense tape. The company's IT modernization and digital defense contracts (including Trusted Mission AI initiatives with DoD) provide multi-year revenue visibility, and bullish options + institutional flow confirm smart money accumulation. Entry now captures continued defense budget tailwinds ahead of FY27 appropriations.

AVAV is the pure-play on autonomous drone warfare — Switchblade loitering munitions and Puma UAS are seeing surging demand from Ukraine, Taiwan, and expanded DoD replenishment orders. Unlike primes, AVAV offers small-cap growth optionality ($7.6B) with bullish options and institutional signals aligning. The Ukraine/Middle East drone doctrine shift makes this a structural, not cyclical, growth story.

L3Harris differentiates from primes via tactical communications, electronic warfare, and space payloads — high-margin niches benefiting from Golden Dome missile defense architecture and SDA satellite awards. Bullish options + institutional flow with more moderate 1M gain (+5.7%) suggests room to run vs. more-extended peers like LDOS/DRS. Aerojet Rocketdyne integration continues driving margin expansion.

PATH is the highest-conviction non-defense pick and adds critical theme diversification — enterprise automation is pivoting from pure RPA to agentic AI workflows, where UiPath's install base gives it a distribution moat. At 3.7x P/S with a $6.1B cap, valuation reflects prior disappointment but bullish options + institutional accumulation suggest a turnaround narrative is forming. Watch for earnings confirmation before sizing up.

SMCI is the contrarian pick — the only screened name with negative 1M performance (-0.6%) despite bullish options and institutional signals, offering a mean-reversion setup on the leading AI server/liquid-cooling vendor. At just 0.5x P/S, valuation has fully discounted prior accounting/governance overhangs, while Blackwell rack shipments should reaccelerate revenue in H2. Diversifies the list into semis/AI infrastructure away from defense concentration.
